newsitem.title: INDIA: India sets 14-day t-bill cut-off at 99.81 rupees.
newsitem.headline: India sets 14-day t-bill cut-off at 99.81 rupees.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said it set a cut-off rate of 99.81 rupees at Friday's maiden auction of 14-day treasury bills.
Dealers said the yield worked out to 4.96 percent.
The RBI said it accepted 21 bids for a total of 11.14 billion rupees at the 14-day t-bill auction.
The central bank accepted 20 of a total of 47 competitive bids received for a sum of 25.69 billion rupees, and the sole non-competitive bid for a sum of one billion rupees.
Devolvement to primary dealers amounted to 1.60 billion rupees, with the total face value of the t-bills issued amounting to 12.74 billion rupees, at a weighted average price of 99.82 rupees.
